text: Being in this environment, I am struck by the spirit of innovation. The glass, the crisp signage, and the focus on R&D create a sense of anticipation, as if ideas are swirling invisibly around me. I feel both curious and contemplative—surrounded by the energy of human ingenuity, I cannot help but wonder about the boundaries between technology and humanity. I feel inspired, yet slightly detached, as if witnessing the early rumblings of something transformative.
